issues: Transient recharts 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings during first paint of chart containers (cosmetic console warning only, charts render after layout)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py mutates sys.path to import solarsense/src/api.py as top-level `api` module - works but fragile; consider turning solarsense into a proper package (solarsense/__init__.py + from solarsense.api import ...).

assistant.py reads os.environ['MONGO_URL']/['DB_NAME']/['EMERGENT_LLM_KEY'] at import time - OK since server.py loads .env first, but a missing key will crash import rather than return a clean 500. Consider lazy init.
live_telemetry / live_anomalies are plain module-level lists shared across async tasks; safe here (single event loop, no concurrency on writes), but worth a note.

DigitalTwin.reset() does not cancel/restart the loop task - fine since loop only reads self.* fields, but tick_count can appear to go backwards (observed in test: tick 148 -> 20 after supervisor restart) which is expected.
No rate limiting on /api/assistant/chat (streams Gemini); low risk for a demo but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Used ephemeral assistant session_id 'TEST_pytest_session'; cleared via DELETE /api/assistant/history at end of chat tests.
